## Summary

`skill/code_review/scripts/linter_runner.py` scoped-lint path hands the raw git changed-file list to eslint without an extension filter. When the changed-file list contains a Python file (.py), eslint v6.4.0 parses it as JavaScript and emits a fatal "Parsing error: Unterminated string constant" — surfaced as a blocking high-severity finding that fails audits closed (Phase 1 decision gate), even though the flagged file is valid Python and unrelated to the item under audit.

discovered-from:SA-0MSKM2LSP006L0K8

## Root cause

- `_run_eslint_findings_check` (`skill/code_review/scripts/linter_runner.py:351`): `cmd = ["eslint", *[str(f) for f in files], "-f", "json", "--quiet"]` — passes raw `files` with no extension filter.
- `_run_eslint_fix_mode` (`:722`, `:727`): same gap.
- By contrast, ruff scoping filters to Python extensions: `py_files = [f for f in files if str(f).endswith((".py", ".pyi", ".pyx"))]` (`:392`, `:641`).
- Consequence (observed 2026-09-20): audit of SA-0MSKM2LSP006L0K8 returned "Ready to close: No" because an unrelated uncommitted `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py` modification entered the changed-file scope and eslint mis-parsed it, demoting a previously completed/in_review item to open/plan_complete.

## Reproduction (read-only)

eslint skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py -f json --quiet  -> fatal "Parsing error: Unterminated string constant" (1:3)
eslint skill/audit/scripts/scan.py -f json --quiet             -> identical error (unrelated committed .py)
eslint tests/node/<any>.mjs -f json --quiet                    -> [] (clean)
python3 -m py_compile skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py -> OK (valid Python)

Same class of bug as CG-0MSXL2L0T009CA3I (ruff mis-parsing .ts files, 627 false positives) — fixed for ruff but not for eslint.

## Suggested fix

- Filter the scoped `files` list in `_run_eslint_findings_check` / `_run_eslint_fix_mode` to JS/TS extensions (.js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs, .ts, .tsx) before building the eslint command; skip eslint entirely (return []) when no JS/TS targets remain — mirror the ruff guard.
- Whole-project mode (empty/absent files list) already avoids the issue: `eslint <root>` with no explicit targets only lints default JS extensions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Scoped eslint runs filter file targets to JS/TS extensions; a .py-only changed-file list produces zero eslint findings (eslint skipped or given no JS/TS targets).
- [ ] Unit test asserts no eslint invocation / no findings when the scoped file list contains only non-JS/TS files.
- [ ] An audit whose changed-file scope contains only .py files completes without an eslint "Parsing error" blocking finding (regression).
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **SA-0MS1TD0U70018IXR** – Clean remaining references and verify test suite (completed)
- **SA-0MUAG0C7P008X3SE** – Update tests: migrate existing tests, add AC1-AC7 coverage (open)
- **SA-0MSQ012QG005N22S** – Test runner: pytest not found on PATH in non-login shells (open)

### Repository file matches
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, audit (+121 more)
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, asserts (+114 more)
- `skill/audit/SKILL.md` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, audit (+102 more)

## Failure Signature

- Test name: tests/test_cleanup_integration.py::test_cleanup_scripts_dry_run_cli
- Failing commit: 0d0d0fc0ab144e796ce616d8f5436e6a70dd4bed
- CI job: (not available)

## Evidence

- Short stderr/stdout excerpt (first 1k characters):

```
live-repo mutation detected during tests/test_cleanup_integration.py::test_cleanup_scripts_dry_run_cli:
  added config   branch.wl-SA-0MU32TAMB007HI99-r1-audit-debug-log-mislabels-every-succe.merge=refs/heads/dev
  added config   branch.wl-SA-0MU32TAMB007HI99-r1-audit-debug-log-mislabels-every-succe.remote=.
```

## Root Cause (evidence-backed)

The named test is **not defective** — it is the *victim* of a false positive in
the live-repo mutation guard (F5, SA-0MUG30JSE0069JEQ). The guard fails whichever
test finishes next when the main checkout's shared `.git/config` changes mid-run:

- `implement.py::git_worktree_add()` runs `git worktree add --track -b <branch> <path> dev`,
  which writes `branch.<branch>.remote=.` and `branch.<branch>.merge=refs/heads/dev`
  into the **main checkout's shared `.git/config`**.
- `skill/shared/git_sandbox.py::snapshot_repo_state()` captures **all** local config
  (`git config --local --list`).
- `fingerprint()` (`skill/shared/git_sandbox.py:414`) and `diff_snapshots()`
  (`:446-455`) filter agent-worktree **refs** via `excluded_refs`, but do **not**
  filter the matching `branch.<excluded-ref>.{remote,merge}` config keys.
- `live_repo_guard.py::pytest_runtest_teardown` therefore sees a config diff caused
  by a concurrent agent's `implement.py start` and fails the next test to finish —
  here the ~6.7 s cleanup integration test.

This is the same guard false-positive class as SA-0MUILGH5E007X627 (worktree-root
anchoring / ref churn) and SA-0MUII5QDI005U2AH (shared `refs/stash` churn), and
reproduces the root cause first identified for SA-0MUIP4PAG005YI91 (closed as a
false positive without a guard fix).

## Steps To Reproduce

1. Checkout the commit: `git checkout 0d0d0fc0ab144e796ce616d8f5436e6a70dd4bed`
2. Run the failing test: `pytest -q -r a --disable-warnings -k tests/test_cleanup_integration.py::test_cleanup_scripts_dry_run_cli` (or equivalent command)
3. Capture full logs and attach to the work item

## Impact

Failing test detected by agent during automated run. May block PR creation for the agent's current work item. Because the guard misattributes a concurrent
worktree's config churn to an unrelated test, the failure is non-deterministic and
will recur on any shared host with more than one active agent session.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The test `tests/test_cleanup_integration.py::test_cleanup_scripts_dry_run_cli` passes when run against the latest `dev`.
2. The live-repo mutation guard no longer reports a mutation for `branch.<worktree-branch>.remote` / `.merge` config churn written by a concurrent `implement.py start` / worktree registration. Verification: a test mutates the shared `.git/config` branch keys for a branch present in `excluded_refs` and asserts `diff_snapshots(before, after)["changed"] is False` and `fingerprint()` is unchanged.
3. Genuine in-place checkout mutations are still reported (moved `HEAD`/branch ref, tracked-file edit, untracked non-ignored file, unrelated config change); the existing guard contract tests remain green.
4. Documentation describing the guard's exclusion surface (e.g. `docs/dev/test-isolation.md` and the `git_sandbox.py` docstring) is updated to state that worktree-branch config keys are excluded.
5. Full project test suite passes with the new changes.

## Related Work

- **SA-0MUILGH5E007X627** — live-repo guard false-positives inside an agent worktree (concurrent worktree ref churn) (open)
- **SA-0MUII5QDI005U2AH** — Live-repo guard: shared refs/stash causes spurious mutation failures across concurrent worktrees (open)
- **SA-0MUIP4PAG005YI91** — same failure signature; closed as a false positive without a guard fix (completed)

## Key Files:

- `tests/test_cleanup_integration.py`
- `skill/shared/git_sandbox.py`
- `skill/shared/live_repo_guard.py`
- `scripts/cleanup/prune_local_branches.py`
- `scripts/cleanup/cleanup_stale_remote_branches.py`
- `docs/dev/test-isolation.md`

## Suggested Triage Steps

1. Verify flakiness: rerun CI/test locally once.
2. If reproducible, assign to `Build` and route for triage.
3. If flaky, tag `flaky` and route to flaky-test queue.

## Suspected Owner

Build (confidence: 0.0, reason: no owner inference available)

## Links

- Runbook: skill/triage/resources/runbook-test-failure.md
- CI artifacts: (not available)

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

Plan skill auto-skip path (effort Extra Small, risk Low): no interactive interview was
run. Questions arising from automated review are recorded below.

- **OPEN QUESTION** (directed to: producer / Build): the guard false-positive class already
  has two open items (SA-0MUILGH5E007X627, SA-0MUII5QDI005U2AH). Should the `branch.<ref>.*`
  config-key filter be implemented here (as AC2 implies), or folded into SA-0MUILGH5E007X627
  as the single shared `git_sandbox.py` fix — with this item then closed as a duplicate symptom?
  Why it matters: proceeding here without a decision risks two divergent fixes to the same helper.
  Recommendation: fold into SA-0MUILGH5E007X627 and close this item as a duplicate, unless the
  producer prefers this item to carry the regression test.
- **Q:** Is the named test itself in scope for change? **Answer (plan review):** no. The test is
  valid; it is only the guard's attribution that is wrong. Evidence: the previous root-cause
  analysis for SA-0MUIP4PAG005YI91 and the reproduction above.

## Goal

Implement global test-job pacing (semaphore/queue) so only N test suites run simultaneously, preventing resource oversubscription. This umbrella ties the remaining pacing gaps into coherent implementation tasks.

## Producer Decisions (SA-0MUJL211C008GHMZ, producer answers to intake Q1-Q3)

- **Q1 = A:** This item is the **umbrella/epic** for the remaining pacing gaps. Decomposed into children below; overlapping open items reconciled by reparenting.
- **Q2 = test skill:** The test skill owns routing all test executions through the pacer. Each child integrates its respective code path through the shared `"test"` semaphore namespace.
- **Q3 = env for now:** Keep env-var mechanism (`TEST_MAX_CONCURRENCY`/`TEST_LOCK_TIMEOUT`); no new config file, no `pace-run.sh` wrapper.

## Children (gap decomposition)

| Child | Title | Stage | Notes |
|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| SA-0MUG47DYG006TV40 | test-infra: child-audit cascade can recursively execute the full suite | plan_complete | Source of audit F3 gap |
| SA-0MUJK94QN0015925 | test/audit: audit F3 auto-execution bypasses the test concurrency semaphore | idea | Discovered-from SA-0MUG47DYG006TV40 |
| SA-0MUKHCO02009EQFG | Route implement.py test execution through the test skill pacer | idea | New - implements.py bypass |
| SA-0MUA8BSAG000YZA2 | Browser suite contention: TEST_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2 starvation | idea | Reparented from SA-0MTG0Y34T007ZHPF |

**Dependency ordering:** No hard blockers between children. The cascade (SA-0MUG47DYG006TV40, plan_complete) may be implemented first. The audit F3 bypass (SA-0MUJK94QN0015925) overlaps with cascade - coordinate to avoid duplicate changes. The other two are independent.

## Acceptance Criteria (epic)

- AC1: All children are in `in_review`/`completed` stage.
- AC2: Full test suite runs without unpaced `run_cached()` invocations in implement.py, audit runner, or cascade paths.
- AC3: Load averaging under 2x oversubscription on a 16-core host during concurrent multi-agent sessions.

## Out of scope

- New pacing config file (producer Q3 rejected)
- `pace-run.sh` wrapper script
- Audit semaphore changes (separate namespace, not in scope)

## Related items

- SA-0MTG0Y34T007ZHPF - Multi-agent audit/test coordination (broader, in-progress by another agent). The pacing gaps are a subset of its concerns.
